recommendation: Rinse when appropriate and place clean plastic in the recycling stream.
Keep paper clean and dry; send it to paper recycling.
Separate glass from general waste and use a suitable glass collection point.
Separate metal items and send them to an appropriate metal recycling stream.
Compost suitable food and garden waste where a composting option is available.
Do not put electronics in ordinary rubbish; use an authorised e-waste collection point.
